summary: The design addresses real losses in the adapter, but several proposed paths still cannot preserve the stated semantics with the existing wire and renderer contracts. The highest risks are progress targets/percentage scaling, missing dual-axis support in the infographic HTML and admin chart stack, and locale-dependent formatter parity.

suggestions.title: Progress targets have no existing A2UI destination
suggestions.rationale: ProgressBlock.title and ProgressItem.target are rendered by the HTML lane, but the adapter lowers each item to KPICard and KPICARD_SCHEMA has no target or progress component. Decide whether target/title loss is explicitly accepted, represented through an existing sanctioned extension, or requires revisiting the no-vocabulary-change constraint.

suggestions.title: Define the 0–100 progress to ratio conversion explicitly
suggestions.rationale: ProgressItem.value is validated as a 0–100 percentage, while KPICard.format='percent' and the admin formatter interpret values as ratios, such as 0.683 → 68.3%. Forwarding 90.4 with format='percent' would display 9,040%; specify and test the canonical conversion, including target handling and zero values.

suggestions.title: Implement dual axes in the template HTML lane, not only A2UI renderers
suggestions.rationale: The existing infographic HTML chart builder creates one yAxis and never assigns yAxisIndex from a series axis; its currency behavior is also inferred from y_axis_label. The A2UI ECharts and interactive HTML renderers already support seriesAxes/yAxisLabels, so the proposed parity is incomplete unless infographic_html.py gets explicit axis routing and labels too.

suggestions.title: The admin chart scope includes AppChart, not just the A2UI adapter
suggestions.rationale: a2ui-chart-adapter.ts currently maps wire props into ChartBlockData, but ChartBlockData, InfographicChartBlock, AppChartConfig, and AppChart.svelte have no series-axis or dual-axis fields and render only a left axis. Updating one adapter file cannot make the admin UI honor the new wire hints.

suggestions.title: Resolve the unaddressed table styling contract
suggestions.rationale: The accepted problem identifies ColumnDef.align as dropped, but Option B only forwards type and format. TableColumn has no align, width, or color fields, so the stated no-loss table parity cannot preserve those existing ColumnDef hints without an extension or an explicit non-goal.

suggestions.title: Do not claim byte-identical formatting without a locale policy
suggestions.rationale: Python format_cell hardcodes comma/dot formatting, while formatA2UIValue uses Intl.NumberFormat(undefined), whose separators and currency placement depend on the browser locale. Shared JSON fixtures can pass in one locale and still drift in production; define a locale/rounding contract or pass an explicit locale before making parity a hard guarantee.

suggestions.title: Numeric hero value zero is currently discarded by the adapter
suggestions.rationale: _hero_card uses block.get('value') or '', so a valid numeric value of 0 becomes an empty string. Widening HeroCardBlock.value to numeric makes this an immediate regression unless the adapter uses an explicit None check; add a regression test for zero and numeric strings.

suggestions.title: Specify progress sectioning as a block-boundary rule
suggestions.rationale: The adapter currently opens sections only for later title blocks and dividers, while ProgressBlock.title is merely an HTML heading and is dropped from A2UI. Define whether a titled progress block opens a new section, whether untitled progress stays in the current section, and how consecutive titled blocks behave; add tests because Infographic.svelte changes to tabs when there is more than one section.

suggestions.title: Make DataFrame dtype inference a tested, bounded contract
suggestions.rationale: _build_table_block currently emits only string column names and raw rows. The proposal says it derives types from pandas dtypes, but does not define nullable integers, booleans, datetimes, categorical values, mixed/object columns, or unsupported formats. Specify the mapping and whether unknown types omit metadata, then test representative dtypes before relying on inference as semantic data.

suggestions.title: Add end-to-end lane parity tests beyond formatter fixtures
suggestions.rationale: The current adapter tests cover sectioning, basic chart/table mapping, purity, and golden lowering, while formatter tests cover isolated Python or TypeScript behavior. Add one fixture containing numeric hero values, typed table columns, progress, and a right-axis chart; assert adapter output, template HTML visible values/axis config, admin adapter props, and lowered A2UI metadata together.
